summary: Tested the new staff invite flow (password removal + email-based invite). Full backend + UI coverage: Add User modal in People Hub has NO password field, submits via POST /api/org/invite-user, creates pending user with is_active=False, shows 'Invite pending' badge in People & Usage and 'Pending' row in Invites tab. Resend button calls POST /api/org/invite-user/{id}/resend (returns 200, no alert() dialog). Revoke button fully deletes the user. The email_failed fallback correctly returns invite_link + email_failed:true (verified via curl with bad@example.com). End-to-end accept-invite flow via API verified: invite -> /auth/invite/{token} verify -> /auth/accept-invite with user-chosen password -> user flips to is_active=True -> new user can log in with their own password. OrgStructure invite flow source-verified (no password field, 'Send Invite' button w/ data-testid=save-invite-btn, 72h copy). Super Admin invite regression: endpoint exists; could not UI-login due to mandatory MFA, so marked as code-level regression only — invite_admin_core -> invite_user_core rename is in place and compiles.

minor.issue: List response omits/returns null for 'must_change_password' field on invited (pending) users even though DB has it TRUE — not functionally broken (is_active=False is the primary pending signal UI uses), but inconsistent.

critical_code_review_comments: GOOD: /api/org/invite-user and /resend both enforce 'admin'/'manager' role AND rate-limit at 20/hour per org — matches admin-invite pattern.

GOOD: Resend handler calls check_rate_limit BEFORE regenerating token, and marks any still-open invitation row as used before inserting the new one — token rotation is atomic from the client's perspective.
GOOD: Modal removes password field entirely; falls back to amber info box + copyable invite link when Resend fails (verified bad@example.com returns email_failed:true + invite_link).

Minor: /api/admin/users does not return must_change_password for pending users (null in response). Frontend relies on is_active=False which works, but exposing the flag would make the API more self-descriptive.
Minor: PeopleHub Invites tab shows both 'Pending' and 'Expired' statuses correctly — threshold switched from 7d to 72h to match real token TTL (per changelog).

success_rate.backend: 100% (6 passed, 2 skipped due to env-level MFA)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (invite create, pending badge, Invites tab, resend API 200, revoke, accept-invite E2E, no-password UI, 'Send Invite' label)

test_credentials: admin@supervision.com / Admin123!X (Test Company org). Super admin UI test blocked by mandatory MFA; backend regression verified by code inspection.
seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up multiple TEST_ / test-ui-* / accept-flow-* / bad@example.com invites during the run — all deleted via DELETE /api/admin/users/{id} teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file /app/backend/tests/test_iter167_invite_password_removal.py covers invite without password, pending user visibility, resend token rotation, revoke-deletes-invitation. Run with: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<url> python -m pytest backend/tests/test_iter167_invite_password_removal.py -v -o 'addopts='. Super admin invite is MFA-gated — use get_tokens.py helper if you need to UI-test it.
rca of the issue: No issue found — feature works as specified.
